items.name: Wrightsville Beach Sloop Printed Canvas Tote Bag
items.alt: Natural canvas tote bag with a navy panel of small sailboats printed on the front, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed canvas tote with a navy panel of little sloops on the front. Roomy enough for a beach day or a Wilmington errand run.
facts: About 15 x 16 in with 20 in handles
Sailboat pattern panel on the front
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

items.name: Wrightsville Beach Sloop Can Cooler Sleeve
items.alt: Navy can cooler sleeve covered in small sailboats around a regular can, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A navy can cooler sleeve covered in little sloops, printed edge to edge. Keeps a regular can cool on the boat, the sand or the porch.
facts: Fits a regular can, about 3.5 x 4.3 in
Polyester outside, soft foam liner inside
Sailboat pattern printed edge to edge
